selected_evidence.summary: The persistent GRUB setting and generated kernel entries contain `audit=1`; GRUB regeneration succeeded.
The active kernel command line contains exactly one `audit=1`; kernel logs report auditing enabled and initialized.

Healthy pre-restart state and boot ID were captured, restart acknowledgement returned, boot ID changed from `4b7ded33-b5e2-42c9-b7f2-bd671942a82d` to `bdd4591d-4387-42df-a4af-219d51c6e37f`, and post-restart configuration, SSH, filesystem, and systemd health were verified.
